results.title: Ahmedabad Ready to Host Historic Commonwealth Games 2030: Harsh Sanghavi
results.description: Speaking at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games closing ceremony, Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi said Ahmedabad is fully prepared to host the historic centenary edition of the Commonwealth Games in 2030, calling it a sacred responsibility for India.

results.title: 'He'd be made up there's a cup named after him' after memorial match to club stalwart
results.description: A memorial cup was held for the first time to celebrate the life of their former reserve team manager.

results.title: Yankees, Nationals trade grades for Luis Garcia Jr. blockbuster before deadline
results.description: The Yankees paid a huge price to bring Luis Garcia Jr. in from the Nationals, but they needed a power bat badly amid their injuries.

results.title: Heat's Bam Adebayo gives blunt feelings on LeBron James signing with 76ers instead of Miami
results.description: The Miami Heat were in full pursuit for LeBron James. The four-time NBA champion signed with the Philadelphia 76ers and Bam Adebayo made his feelings on the situation known.
